title: Nested If
concept: Put an if inside another if to check multiple conditions hierarchically — only check the second if the first passes.
why: Some conditions only make sense after another is true. 'If it's raining AND you have no umbrella' needs hierarchy.
tips: Inner `if` only runs when the outer `if` condition is true
Use indentation to make the nesting structure visible
If nesting goes >3 levels deep, refactor — it's probably too complex
Consider using `&&` instead of nested `if` when conditions are independent
common_mistakes: Losing track of which `}` closes which block — match braces carefully
Nesting when `&&` would be cleaner and more readable
Forgetting that inner if-else only applies within the outer if
